verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a unified dashboard/CLI/MCP surface for logs: build logs (get_deployment_build_logs, errorsOnly), runtime logs and grouped runtime errors (get_runtime_logs/get_runtime_errors), framework-aware monitoring across traffic, function performance, and errors (vercel-docs-30), plus CLI log retrieval (vercel-docs-47) and webhooks for deployment lifecycle events. This spans build, deploy, and runtime observability in one place via dashboard, CLI, and MCP. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming the unified logs UX in practice, and no detail on log retention limits or cross-project aggregation depth.
